tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Administration: users, server settings (general, security, SMTP, IMAP, files, media, TV), audit log, library spaces, the category taxonomy and database backups. Requires the `admin` role; tokens additionally need the `admin` scope.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Filter by username, email or display name (substring, case-insensitive).

200.description: A page of users sorted by username.

409.description: Username or email already in use.

patch.description:
Change role, disabled flag, quota, email, display name or verification state. Demoting or disabling the **last admin** is refused with 409.

**Scope:** `admin`

409.description: Would remove the last active admin, or email already in use.

delete.description:
Deletes the account, its sessions/tokens, notes, vault, workbooks, lineups and channels. With `delete_files=true` the home space and its files are deleted too; otherwise the home space is kept for an admin to recover. You cannot delete yourself or the last admin.

**Scope:** `admin`

parameters.name: delete_files
parameters.description: Also delete the user's home space and files.

409.description: Cannot delete yourself or the last admin.

post.description:
Sets a new password and revokes all of the user's sessions and session tokens.

**Scope:** `admin`

post.summary: Revoke all sessions of a user
post.description:
Logs the user out everywhere (cookie sessions and `lws_` tokens). Personal access tokens are revoked as well.

**Scope:** `admin`

delete.description:
Removes the TOTP secret and recovery codes (e.g. lost phone). The user can enrol again.

**Scope:** `admin`

get.description:
Every settings namespace (`general`, `security`, `smtp`, `imap`, `files`, `media`, `tv`). Secret fields (`smtp.password`, `imap.password`, `media.tmdb_api_key`) are redacted to `{"set": true|false}`.

**Scope:** `admin`

patch.description:
Partial update: include any namespaces and keys. For secret fields send a string to set, `null` to clear, or omit to keep. Values are validated per namespace (422 with `details.fields` keyed `namespace.key`). Returns the full redacted settings. Every change is audited.

**Scope:** `admin`

post.description:
Sends a test message with the **saved** SMTP settings.

**Scope:** `admin`

204.description: Message accepted by the SMTP server.

502.description: `smtp_failed`: the SMTP server rejected the connection or message.

post.description:
Logs in with the **saved** IMAP settings, lists mailboxes and counts unseen messages in the configured mailbox. Does not modify anything.

**Scope:** `admin`

get.description:
Authentication events (logins, failures, logouts, password/TOTP changes, token create/revoke) and every admin action, newest first.

**Scope:** `admin`

post.description:
Writes a consistent online copy of the SQLite database with `VACUUM INTO <data>/backups/ludworks-<timestamp>.db`. File contents in `<data>/storage` are not included — back those up separately.

**Scope:** `admin`
